desc: Register and supervise external plugin services, accessed through Gately's reverse proxy.
pageDesc: This page is served by the plugin service, proxied through Gately.
secretOnce: Plugin secret (shown only once; give it to the plugin to verify proxied requests):
title: Plugin Center
sourceHint: Pick one: index URL or local directory. A local directory source reads index.json inside the directory. The official index URL is not published yet and stays empty in this release.
marketEmpty: No plugins from this source, or the index has not been refreshed
officialEmpty: The official index URL is not published yet: the official source is an empty placeholder in this release. Add a community source or install from a local directory / uploaded package instead.
localHint: The directory must contain plugin.json; it is copied into the plugin directory, the source directory is left untouched.
optionsHint: JSON object; a running command plugin restarts on save so the new options take effect.
optionsUrlNote: For URL plugins, options are only recorded, not delivered to the plugin (its own deployment carries its config).
optionsInvalid: Options must be a valid JSON object
